{{Quote|Come on, now&hellip;we had to follow orders. I know you wanted to land the Millennium Falcon and the Cobra right in your own backyard&hellip;but when we radioed the control tower, they specified that our landing clearance was for this spaceport only.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 91">[[Star Wars (1977) 91|''Star Wars'' (1977) 91]]</ref>}}
'''Rwookrrorro Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] outside the [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]] settlement.

==History==
It contained a [[Control tower/Legends|control tower]] which directed entering [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to their landing spots. The houses of Rwookrrorro were a fair distance away from the spaceport, but the distance could be covered by a short walk.

Around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were forced to land at the Rwookrrorro Spaceport, despite Chewbacca's desire to land the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] directly next to his house. It was apparently illegal to land in unapproved locations. Calrissian refused to ignore orders from the control tower to land at the spaceport, despite Chewbacca's protests, as he did not want to break Kashyyyk law.
